items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿夺法拉利首杆：仿佛回到看舒马赫时代
items.summaryZh: 汉密尔顿在墨西哥城大奖赛排位赛中以0.009秒优势击败前队友拉塞尔，拿下个人法拉利生涯首个大奖赛杆位，也成为在三个不同车队都获得杆位的车手。他表示这让他回想起当年看舒马赫统治法拉利的时光。

media.altZh: 汉密尔顿夺法拉利首杆：仿佛回到看舒马赫时代 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton: First Ferrari F1 pole “takes me back to watching Michael”
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton took his first grand prix pole position for Ferrari at the Mexico City Grand Prix, beating former teammate George Russell by just 0.009 seconds and becoming a pole winner for three different teams. The seven-time champion said it took him back to watching Michael Schumacher dominate with the Italian team.
detailZh: 汉密尔顿夺法拉利首杆：仿佛回到看舒马赫时代
这位七届世界冠军表示，他在墨西哥城大奖赛的杆位是对法拉利给予他“信任”的回报
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更远地方的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析与比赛反应。
汉密尔顿在今日跑出惊艳一圈、拿下明日墨西哥城大奖赛杆位后，终于可以说自己已在三个不同车队获得杆位——这是他代表法拉利的首个大奖赛杆位。这位七届冠军表示，这让他回想起当年看迈克尔·舒马赫随这支意大利车队统治赛场的时光。
汉密尔顿以仅0.009秒的优势击败了前队友乔治·拉塞尔，查尔斯·勒克莱尔驾驶另一辆法拉利获得第三名，跻身前三。
在排位赛后的新闻发布会上，汉密尔顿承认已经过去太久了，他几乎记不清自己上一次拿到杆位是什么时候。
“我想我已经很久没有坐在这个位置上了。我真的不太记得上一次拿到杆位是什么时候了。还有，就像和法拉利一起踏上这段旅程，以及我们经历的所有挑战和起起伏伏。”
汉密尔顿表示，这个结果是法拉利对他信任的回报，而且由于车队与舒马赫的历史渊源，这个成绩具有额外的意义。
“我认为这源于我对车队的信任，也源于他们给我的机会，以及他们对我寄予的信念和信心。能用杆位回报他们，感觉太棒了。
“而且拿到你第一个法拉利杆位，我的天，这让我回想起看着迈克尔在法拉利时拿下那么多杆位，还有那么多胜利。所以这非常、非常特别。”
舒马赫在2000年至2004年间随法拉利赢得了他七个世界冠军中的五个。汉密尔顿后来在2020年随梅赛德斯追平了七冠纪录。
今天的杆位是在一个艰难的周五之后取得的，当时汉密尔顿在第二节练习中被迫停在赛道上，错过了高油量长距离测试。
汉密尔顿表示：“显然，当赛车停在赛道上，我们失去了所有人都能完成的长距离测试，但还是要继续抱有希望，相信总有一天，当我们把赛车调校到位后，我们能重返头排并拿下第一。”
“那一圈真的非常非常干净。我需要这一圈，因为我觉得查尔斯在第一轮跑中快了三四十分之一秒，在最后一圈要追回这么大的差距相当困难，但我知道自己可以在哪些地方改进。”
2025赛季是汉密尔顿在法拉利的第一个赛季，他经历了不少困难，未能登上大奖赛领奖台。但来到墨西哥时他在车手积分榜上排名第三，他现在希望能超越仅领先他一分的拉塞尔。
他从未在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道从杆位发车。
“显然，到1号弯的距离非常长。我觉得我以前从未在这里拿过杆位，”他补充道。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton: First Ferrari F1 pole “takes me back to watching Michael”
The seven-time world champion says his Mexico City Grand Prix pole is a reward for the “belief” Ferrari has shown in him
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Lewis Hamilton can finally say he has scored pole position for three different teams after a blistering lap today gave him pole for tomorrow's Mexico City Grand Prix - his first grand prix pole for Ferrari. The seven-time champion says it took him back to watching Michael Schumacher dominate with the Italian team.
Hamilton beat his former team-mate George Russell by just 0.009 seconds, with Charles Leclerc rounding out the top three in the other Ferrari.
Speaking in the post-qualifying press conference, Hamilton admitted it had been so long that he could barely remember his last pole.

“It’s been a long time since I think I’ve sat in this spot. I don’t really remember the last time I had a pole. And like embarking on this journey with Ferrari and all the challenges and ups and downs we’ve had.”
Hamilton said the result was a reward for the faith Ferrari had shown in him, and that it carried extra meaning because of the team’s history with Schumacher.

“I think just my belief in this team, I think the opportunity that they’re giving me and the belief that they’ve put and faith they’ve put in me also. It feels great to be able to reward them with a pole.
“And to have your first Ferrari pole, I mean, jeez, it just takes me back to watching Michael get all those pole positions when he was with Ferrari, and all those wins. So it’s very, very special.”
Schumacher won five of his seven world titles with Ferrari between 2000 and 2004. Hamilton went on to equal his record of seven championships in 2020 with Mercedes.
Today's pole came after a difficult Friday where Hamilton was forced to stop on track during FP2, missing his long run with a high fuel load.

“Obviously, when the car stopped on track and we lost the long run that everyone got to do, but just continuing to hold on to that hope that one day we’ll get back on the front row and to P1 once we dialled the car in,” Hamilton said.

“It was a really, really clean lap. I needed it because I mean Charles, I think, was three or four tenths up the road from the first run, and that’s quite a big deficit to close on your last lap, but I knew areas that I could improve on.”

Hamilton has endured a difficult first season with Ferrari in 2025, failing to score a grand prix podium. But as he arrived in Mexico third in the drivers' standings, he is now hoping he can overtake Russell, who sits just a single point ahead of him.
He has never started from pole at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez.
“It’s obviously a really long way down to Turn 1. I don’t think I’ve ever been on pole here before,” he added.

items.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar defends Mexican GP paddock incident after FIA warning: "Not a reality show"
items.summaryEn: Isack Hadjar has defended pushing away a paddock guest who tried to take a selfie with him at the Mexican Grand Prix, insisting that "it's not a reality show". He was summoned to the stewards and found to have breached the International Sporting Code.
detailZh: 哈贾尔在墨西哥大奖赛围场推人事件后回应国际汽联警告：“这不是真人秀”
哈贾尔为在墨西哥大奖赛推开一名围场访客辩护
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术解析与比赛分析。
哈贾尔回击了他在墨西哥大奖赛推开的那名围场访客，坚称“这不是真人秀”。
周六上午，这位红牛车手被传唤至赛会干事处，此前社交媒体上的视频显示他在围场里推搡了一名试图与他自拍的男子。
赛会干事认定哈贾尔违反了国际体育规则，但仅给予他正式警告，并列举了五项减轻处罚的因素。
赛会干事表示：“这名车手是对另一人未经邀请且相当具有攻击性的行为做出的反应。”
“这名车手当时正努力穿过拥挤区域前往第一节自由练习赛的起点，他身边没有足够的安保人员，那名嘉宾未经他同意便侵犯了他的个人空间，这也是车手们在穿行围场时普遍遇到的问题。”
哈贾尔在墨西哥大奖赛排位赛获得第七名后，接受媒体采访时谈到了这一事件。
当被问及是否高兴干事理解了他的观点时，哈贾尔解释道：“是的，因为他们是正确的，这说得通。我很高兴他们做出了正确的决定。我和干事们谈过，他们理解了我的观点。所以，是的，公平竞争。”
当被要求提供更多关于当时情况的细节时，这位法国-阿尔及利亚裔车手补充道：“这也是有界限的，尤其是在那个年纪。当你还是个孩子的时候，我会去拍张照片。
“当我不想拍照，因为你是个成年男人时，不要侵犯我的空间，因为我要去工作；这不是真人秀。我实际上是要去维修区工作。”
哈贾尔的队友马克斯·维斯塔潘最近表示，越来越多的嘉宾让围场感觉“像动物园一样”。哈贾尔对此表示赞同。
“是的，我同意。需要稍微冷静一下，”他说。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar defends Mexican GP paddock incident after FIA warning: "Not a reality show"
Isack Hadjar has defended pushing away a paddock guest at the Mexican Grand Prix
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Isack Hadjar has hit back at the paddock guest he pushed away at the Mexican Grand Prix, insisting that "it's not a reality show".
The Red Bull driver was summoned to the stewards on Saturday morning after footage on social media showed him shoving a man who was trying to take a selfie with him in the paddock.
The stewards found that Hadjar had breached the International Sporting Code, but only handed him a formal warning, citing five mitigating factors.
"The driver was reacting to an uninvited and rather aggressive action by another person," the stewards stated.

"The driver was endeavouring to make his way to the start of FP1 through a congested area, the driver did not have sufficient security present, the guest was invading his personal space without his consent and the general issue drivers have experienced moving through the paddock."
Hadjar addressed the incident while speaking to the media after qualifying seventh for the Mexican Grand Prix.

"I am, because they were right, it makes sense," Hadjar explained when asked if he was glad the stewards understood his point of view. "I'm glad they took the right decision. I was talking to the stewards and they understood my point. So, yeah, fair play."
When asked for more details on the situation, the French-Algerian added: "There's a limit to it, also when you're that age. When you're a kid, I'm going to take a picture.
"When I don't want to take a picture because you're a grown man, don't invade my space, because I'm going to work; it's not a reality show. I'm actually going to work in the garage."
Hadjar's team-mate Max Verstappen recently said the growing number of guests had made the paddock feel "like a zoo". Hadjar agreed.
"Yeah, I agree. It needs to chill a bit," he said.

items.originalTitle: Ryo Hirakawa could have "easily" made Q2 in F1 Mexico GP without late traffic
items.summaryEn: Haas stand-in Ryo Hirakawa believes he would have easily reached the second part of qualifying for the Mexico City Grand Prix had he not encountered traffic on his final lap.
detailZh: 平川亮称墨西哥站排位若无末段交通可轻松进Q2
顶替埃斯特班·奥康出战的车手在他的首场F1大奖赛中排位第19，但他觉得自己本可以取得更好的成绩。
哈斯F1车队车手平川亮，哈斯F1车队的劳拉·穆勒。
哈斯替补车手平川亮认为，若不是在排位赛最后一圈遇到交通，他本可以“轻松”进入墨西哥城大奖赛排位赛的第二部分。
平川亮在F1首秀中代表哈斯车队出场，因为埃斯特班·奥康被暂停了驾驶职责；他跑出了个人最佳的第一赛段成绩，并试图挤掉卡洛斯·塞恩斯进入Q3。
这位日本车手曾两度获得世界耐力锦标赛冠军，随后在第二赛段的连续弯道中遇到亚历克斯·阿尔本而损失了时间，接着又在单圈最后部分遇到了弗兰科·科拉平托。
回顾自己的首次F1排位赛，平川亮称这一圈“很遗憾”，因为他觉得赛道演变已经足够好，本可以让他进入排位赛的中间阶段。
“我在6号弯以及高速路段都遇到了交通状况，所以损失了很多下压力，”平川亮说。
“我本来可以轻松进入Q2，我得说这对我来说是非常非常大的遗憾，但能在这里仍然很好，所以我不能抱怨太多。”
“像这样的环境条件，一旦你打滑，你就能在第三赛段感受到代价。你需要推进，但同时你也需要稍微管理一下。”
平川亮在第一次练习赛中驾驶了赛车，在代替奥康参加周六的各节练习与排位之前，他解释说不得不放弃通常的晨跑，为这个周末做准备。他的第三次练习赛安排大部分都是为了准备周六的排位赛，这使得周日多少有些未知。
他说他的注意力只是放在取得好的起步并干净地通过第一个弯道上——并且不愿透露他是否会在下周蒙扎的决赛中放弃他的世界耐力锦标赛冠军争夺。
平川亮与丰田8号车队的队友塞巴斯蒂安·布埃米和布伦登·哈特利一起，以25分的优势领先于姊妹车7号丰田车组的迈克·康威（这是他退役前的最后一场比赛）、小林可梦伟和尼克·德弗里斯。这意味着7号车组需要获胜并拿下杆位可得的积分。
"我只专注于明天，下周的事情没什么好讨论的。看看明天我们能做些什么。[计划是]一个好的起步、一个好的第一个弯角，还有很多新东西，所以就是执行好并尽我所能。
"我甚至在第三次练习赛开始时尝试在维修区（pit 进站）停下，但比赛情况下会有所不同，不过我认为我应该为此做好了准备。
"我在第一次练习赛中驾驶过，所以经验帮助很大。在第三次练习赛中我并不是从零开始，所以我认为我的情况并非如此。"
detailEn: Ryo Hirakawa could have "easily" made Q2 in F1 Mexico GP without late traffic
Esteban Ocon's replacement qualified 19th for his first F1 grand prix - but feels he could have achieved more
Ryo Hirakawa, Haas F1 Team, Laura Mueller, Haas F1 Team
Haas stand-in Ryo Hirakawa believes he'd have "easily" reached the second part of qualifying for the Mexico City Grand Prix, had he not encountered traffic on his final lap of the session.

Hirakawa, making his Formula 1 debut with Haas as Esteban Ocon was stood down from his driving duties, had set a personal-best first sector and was angling to make the Q3 cut at the expense of Carlos Sainz.

The Japanese driver, a two-time World Endurance Championship winner, then encountered Alex Albon and lost time in the sweeping corners of sector two, then Franco Colapinto in the final part of the lap.

Reflecting on his first F1 qualifying session, Hirakawa labelled the lap as "a shame" as he felt the track evolution had been good enough to grant him an appearance in the intermediate stage of the session.
"I had traffic from Turn 6 and also high-speed sections, so I lost a lot of downforce," Hirakawa said.
"I could have been, I'll say easily to Q2, which is a very, very big shame for me, but still it's nice to be here, so I can't complain much.
"The ambient conditions like this, as soon as you slide you feel the price in sector 3. You need to push, but at the same time you need to manage a bit."

Hirakawa had been in the car for FP1 and, before getting the call-up to drive in Saturday's sessions in lieu of Ocon, explained that he had to abort his usual morning run to prepare for the weekend. Most of his FP3 schedule was done in preparation for Saturday qualifying, which makes Sunday something of an unknown.

He said that his focus was simply on getting a good start and making it through the opening corner cleanly - and would not be drawn on whether he would drop his WEC title tilt next week at the Monza finale.

Hirakawa, along with Toyota #8 team-mates Sebastien Buemi and Brendon Hartley, leads the championship by 25 points over the sister #7 Toyota trio of Mike Conway (in his final outing before retiring), Kamui Kobayashi and Nyck de Vries. This means the #7 would need to win and secure the point available for pole.

"I'm just focused on tomorrow, nothing to discuss for next week. Let's see what we can do for tomorrow. [The plan is] a good start, a good first corner and a lot of new things, so just execute and do my best.
"I even tried stopping at the [pit]box at the FP3 at the start, but it's going to be different in the race circumstances, but I think I should be ready for it.
"I drove in FP1 so the experience helped a lot. I was not starting from zero in FP3, so I don't think it was like that for my case."
